name: Shijou Reo
source:
"Towa, for now, do nothing and shut up."

He is a student at Nijou Crane Academy and vice president of the Nijou-Kai. The  vice president is a well-known figure, and therefore, he is a top student at the school. He is the leader of the students on XR, and for some reason, he is the "Demon King" on XR. 
The Vice President who organizes the school is the Demon King. Even the students on the hostile side of the school council are also a bit relieved. 
Oh, but there is another problem, with the Demon King...? In reality, he and [url=/c113641]Towa[/url] are cousins, and it seems that taking care of her is now his duty.
It's a pity. Will he really have to take care of his cousin in XR? Or is there something he wants to accomplish using his power as Demon King….?

[b][u]GAME SPEC[/u][/b]
Race: Demon
Height: 173 cm
Occupation: Demon King
